trails.name: Numbur Cheese Circuit
trails.why: The Numbur Cheese Circuit is in Ramechhap District of Nepal. This off-the-beaten-path loop links the Khimti and Likhu river valleys around Numbur Himal, passing Sherpa villages, yak pastures, and forest, with simple homestays and teahouses along the way.
